config_rerun.sex_rule: male if log2CPM(RPS4Y1) > log2CPM(XIST), else female
config_rerun.sex_ambiguous_rule: ambiguous samples are removed from every arm, train and test, all seeds
config_rerun.arm_a_rule: pilot pipeline: top n_genes by training variance of log2CPM, training mean/SD scaling
config_rerun.arm_b_rule: per gene, OLS on [1, male] within training (= training group means); residualise train and test with training coefficients; then top n_genes by training residual variance and training mean/SD scaling
config_rerun.arm_c_rule: Arm B genes split at random per seed into candidate and target blocks
config_rerun.pls_iter_rule: one elimination path from all candidates down to min(k_values); each removal is capped so the path stops exactly at every k in k_values (descending); LVs re-chosen by inner CV every round
config_rerun.arms_ab_pls_note: Arms A/B: PLS2 candidates = targets = all genes; flagged degenerate
config_rerun.ranking_rule: consensus = methods ordered by mean test R2 over seeds at k=20 (Arm C: target-block R2; Arms A/B: R2_all); a seed matches if its full order equals the consensus; the arm's ranking holds if matches >= stability_seeds_required
config_rerun.soft_overlap_rule: mean over the two panels of each gene's best |r| to the other panel; |r| on log2CPM of all included samples, sex-residualised with group means for Arms B and C; descriptive only
config_rerun.r3_cost_rule: per seed and k: mean over that seed's greedy misses of (optimum test R2 - greedy test R2); seeds with no miss at that k are left out and counted; then mean and SD over seeds
config_rerun.r3_noise_rule: split-to-split SD = SD over seeds of greedy's mean test R2 over pools at that k
config_rerun.r3_gate_rule: per arm: GO only if, at EVERY k >= r3_gate_k_min, mean cost >= practical_r2_threshold AND mean cost >= sd_multiple x split-to-split SD; the MILP direction continues only if at least one arm is GO
config_rerun.local_search_rule: start from the greedy panel; each iteration try every swap of one panel gene for one non-panel candidate on the TRAINING OLS objective (Gram-matrix formula); accept the best strict improvement; stop when none improves or at max_iter; report training and test (ridge) gain
